# DeadChatWebhook

Copies dead chat to a Discord channel through a plain webhook, one way. Set the `wf.discord.dead_chat_webhook` CVar to
a webhook URL (Channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks); leave it empty to turn it off. Messages post under the
sender's `Character (username)` and never ping anyone. This is separate from the bot-based dead chat link in
`DiscordChatLink`, which is two-way and needs a bot token.

Entry points: `DeadChatWebhookSystem`, which listens for `DeadChatSentEvent`, raised from `ChatSystem.SendDeadChat`.
